notes: READ-ONLY: no Smartsheet writes of any kind were made.

The 'n/NN' tokens in these PDFs are PAGE numbers, not question numbers, and NN varies between submissions of the SAME template (2295 rendered 14, 15 and 17 pages on three different days) purely because photo questions accept multiple images. Do not treat NN as a question count.

A page can carry two question labels and a question's photos can span several pages, so pdftotext reading order occasionally interleaves a label with the wrong page marker. Where that happened the order was resolved by extracting the ambiguous pages individually (-f/-l). Question ORDER is high-confidence; the mapping of photos to pages is not, and does not matter.

Page 1 of a submission sometimes carries only the header block and no question (2295 Manager, Arrival Checklist), and sometimes carries the header plus the first question (812 Manager, 4645 Manager). This is a layout artifact, not a missing question - verified across 3 samples for 2295 and 3 for Arrival.

'Note: -Abby' and 'Status: Done' appear at the tail of several PDFs. These are POST-SUBMISSION reviewer annotations added by the corporate uploader (Abegail Sobrepena), not template questions, and were excluded. Example: the 08/29 Arrival PDF carries 'Note: No picture showing that all the lights are on. -Abby' - exactly the manual QA loop the new app is meant to replace.

Every inferredType is a GUESS derived from how the PDF rendered, not from the Connecteam template definition. Highest-risk guesses, flagged inline: the three 'Unit #' fields (PHOTO vs TEXT), 'Check the parking area...' (PHOTO vs confirmation task), and DueOut 'Is anything broken or missing...' (YESNO vs TEXT).

The 7 live Manager Checklists share an identical tail block (parking-area check, Evictions section, Room number/s, tenant-door photo, Are they still in-house?, Notes/Comments, Signature) and differ ONLY in the property-specific photo list. 2295 is the sole exception on the label 'Guest name & Room #' instead of 'Room number/s'. 44199 additionally omits the parking-area question.
Photo-question counts per Manager Checklist excluding the shared tail: 812=13, 2295=11, 2535=11, 4645=11, 5399=11, 6802=12, 8700=10, 44199=12.

Questions seen in only ONE sample: every question of the 'Lease Arrival/Lease Flip Checklist' (one sample pulled here, plus one previously pulled by another pass) and every question of 'Due Out Room Walk' block-1 sample answers. No question in any other template appeared in fewer samples than were taken - the templates are stable across days and submitters.
Extraction date is 2026-09-01 Eastern. The filename keeps the caller-specified '083126' stamp.
